author: smcarus
title: Will the South African rand be weaker against the US dollar a month after entries close?
summary: Give the probability that rand per US dollar (ECB reference rates crossed to the dollar) is higher, meaning a weaker rand, about a month after entries close than on the day they close. You can practise this kind of question on past data first.
knownLimits: The ECB does not fix on TARGET holidays; the first fixing on or after each date is used.
